title: deriving a schema over any or unknown is refused rather than silently widened
notes:
specification/comptime.mdx, 'Types as Values' read with specification/durable-execution.mdx, 'Durable Boundary': 'any and unknown MUST require an explicit codec at the boundary.' COVERAGE.md 22.2 names this the fail-open direction that matters: a silently widened any produces a validator that accepts anything, which is worse than no validator. Both spellings are declared because they are refused for different type flags (TypeFlags.Any and TypeFlags.Unknown) and a rule that caught only one would leave the other open. The declared columns are the type arguments themselves, which is where the refusal names what it cannot reify.
